input: # Zig's tokenizer emits `.` separately, so whitespace and comments may sit
# `.@"..."` escaped identifiers: any string may name a field or an enum.
# A `\u{...}` escape in an identifier must name a Unicode SCALAR value,
# so U+D7FF and U+E000 stand either side of the surrogate block the zig
# The same byte decoding as a string: `.@"\xe2\x82\xac"` is the euro sign.
